node: Transmission-line hardware, fittings, conductor accessories, and installation-specific components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the physical transmission-line bill-of-materials layer. The cleanest underfollowed candidate is PLPC, which directly designs and manufactures products for energy networks and appears much closer to the specific node than diversified electrical majors. HUBB is the obvious large-cap reference because its Utility Solutions segment includes transmission and distribution components, but exposure is diluted by broader utility, meter, controls, and electrical products. MYRG and ATKR are included as second-order or speculative-shadow names: MYRG as a transmission construction customer/procurement signal for hardware demand, and ATKR as a weaker adjacent electrical-infrastructure component supplier whose direct overhead transmission-line hardware exposure needs verification.
